notes: Four distinct movable parts are manipulated: two separate upper-cabinet doors and two separate wide drawers. Cabinet-door closure ordering is somewhat ambiguous because both doors are closed rapidly between sampled frames 312 and 328.
scene_description: A user moves around a compact kitchen, first opening both doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, then opening the wide drawers on either side of the stove. The cabinet doors and drawers are subsequently closed.
